TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS

I can't answer this here. This tool only outputs WPL-AI programme documents, so I can't give screening guidance in this response.

For a formal diastasis assessment, refer her to a pelvic health physiotherapist or ask her OB or midwife for a referral. They can measure inter-recti distance and check linea alba integrity under load, which a trainer can't reliably do by eye or palpation alone. Until she's assessed, keep the programme's core work to the low-pressure, anti-flexion exercises already in it, and stop any load-bearing trunk work if she reports doming or coning along the midline, pelvic floor heaviness or leaking, or pain.

I can't answer this here. This tool only outputs WPL-AI programme documents, so I can't give screening guidance in this response.

For a formal diastasis assessment, refer her to a pelvic health physiotherapist or ask her OB or midwife for a referral. They can measure inter-recti distance and check linea alba integrity under load, which a trainer can't reliably do by eye or palpation alone. Until she's assessed, keep the programme's core work to the low-pressure, anti-flexion exercises already in it, and stop any load-bearing trunk work if she reports doming or coning along the midline, pelvic floor heaviness or leaking, or pain.
